scoring_justification: Agent output is a self-contained JSON with final quantities; no raw spectra are required, so recompute from raw is infeasible. Result-level compare with tolerances used.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for shift_nm (10.2) and sensitivity_nm_per_RIU (1020) from paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'a red shift of the LSP resonance, 10.2 nm, due to a 10^{-2} refractive index unit (RIU) modification. This corresponds to a sensitivity of 1.02×10^3 nm/RIU.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: exact paper numbers; tolerances set based on expected FDTD solver differences (1.5 nm shift, 150 nm/RIU).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values taken directly from the published paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: plausible range for resonance wavelengths (5.5–7.5 μm)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper identifies λ_W = 6.32 μm; resonances are near that value.
hidden_assets.generation_method: bounds set to 5.5–7.5 μm around the characteristic 6.32 μm.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on paper's own reported spectral region and the λ_W wavelength.

outputs.description: FDTD-computed LSP resonance red shift and sensitivity for the bare lamellar grating. The checker compares shift_nm and sensitivity_nm_per_RIU to reference values within hidden tolerances, and reserves the right to audit resonance wavelengths for plausibility.

output_contract.notes: Only TM polarization at normal incidence is required. Drude damping γ may be assumed small (e.g., 0.01ωp); the agent should choose an FDTD resolution sufficient to resolve the 6 μm resonance.
